text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O got injured during training,
so I had her receive treatment...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry.
I've already been taped up, after all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let us resume our training.
Head straight toward the pinnacle of speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It still aches a bit,
but essentially, as long as I can run in a straight line, it will be fine."
choice_data_list: Still, you won't be able to run at full power like usual, right?
Still, you won't be able to run at full power like normal, will you?
Then, I'll put together a lighter alternative routine.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It still aches a bit,
but essentially, as long as I can run in a straight line, it will be fine."
choice_data_list: Still, you won't be able to run at full power like usual, right?
Still, you won't be able to run at full power like normal, will you?
Then, I'll put together a lighter alternative routine.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: There's no way... actually, maybe there is.
choice_data_list: If you rest now, you'll be able to run at full speed again in no time

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Please tell me that sooner.
I'll be leaving school and taking the day off."

Swift decision, instant action.
Calstone Light O obediently agreed to focus on resting.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: Strength training, reviewing my form, that sort of thing

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see.
If it will make me faster, I'll do whatever it takes.
Please help me.

Favoring the injury might have changed
the way force is applied.

Pushing too hard caused the injury to spread.
It looks like it will take quite a while to fully recover...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Running slowly really doesn't
give that same feeling of fulfillment.
choice_data_list: Top speed comes from proper form!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
One more rep—no, make it ten more, please.
Until a full recovery, she devoted herself to adjusting through a separate, lighter menu...
